annotations.title: Investors: ask a startup founder for an intro through PitchSpark

description: Investors: email one pitch's founders (by pitch_id) a request to connect, with a short message; this cannot be undone. Founders reply inside PitchSpark; their contact details are never returned. Calling again for the same pitch sends a follow-up in the existing conversation. Status: requested, follow_up_sent, already_sent (identical message), already_requested or quota_exhausted. Needs an API key from an investor account (self-declared; PitchSpark does not verify accreditation) or OAuth intros:write. PitchSpark does not verify investors or founders, does not recommend investments and takes no part in any resulting deal.

message.description: Who the investor is and why they are interested. Up to 1000 characters are kept; contact details and links are removed.
